candidates.title: Nyströmformer: A Nystöm-based Algorithm for Approximating Self-Attention
candidates.abstract: Transformers have emerged as a powerful tool for a broad range of natural language processing tasks. A key component that drives the impressive performance of Transformers is the self-attention mechanism that encodes the influence or dependence of other tokens on each specific token. While beneficial, the quadratic complexity of self-attention on the input sequence length has limited its application to longer sequences – a topic being actively studied in the community. To address this limitation, we propose Nyströmformer – a model that exhibits favorable scalability as a function of sequence length. Our idea is based on adapting the Nyström method to approximate standard self-attention with O(n) complexity. The scalability of Nyströmformer enables application to longer sequences with thousands of tokens. We perform evaluations on multiple downstream tasks on the GLUE benchmark and IMDB reviews with standard sequence length, and find that our Nyströmformer performs comparably, or in a few cases, even slightly better, than standard self-attention. On longer sequence tasks in the Long Range Arena (LRA) benchmark, Nyströmformer performs favorably relative to other efficient self-attention methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mlpen/Nystromformer.
candidates.reason: 標準self-attentionの系列長二乗計算・memoryをNyström近似でO(n)へ下げ、長系列で実測memory/time削減を示す効率的attention研究。LLM以前のTransformer研究だが推論計算・memory削減へ直接つながるため収録対象。
candidates.library_body_check: full_text_checked: 一次論文のNyström landmark近似、segment-means、反復pseudo-inverse、value側depthwise convolutionと評価を確認。8192 token条件で標準attention比の大幅なmemory/time削減を示し、LRA/GLUE等で品質を評価。
